queries: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaType, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT MediaType, avg_bpms, avg_bpms - (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) FROM per_type) AS diff_from_overall FROM per_type WHERE avg_bpms > (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) FROM per_type)

WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM per_type) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.avg_bytes_per_ms, p.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_bytes_per_ms > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: 'Pass a cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes' means Bytes >= 10323804 (inclusive).
Per-media-type average is the mean of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios (not total bytes / total milliseconds); Bytes is cast to real to avoid integer division.
The overall average is the unweighted mean across media types that have at least one qualifying track.

alternatives.interpretation: Cutoff is exclusive: only tracks with Bytes strictly greater than 10323804.

assumptions.assumption: 'Pass a cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes' means Bytes >= 10323804 (inclusive threshold); tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded.
Per-track ratio Bytes/Milliseconds is computed with real (non-integer) division, then averaged per media type; the overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type averages.
Media types with no tracks passing the cutoff are excluded from the overall average.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is strict: only tracks with Bytes > 10323804 are considered.
